name: Account Switch Technical Rejection V 02
definition: The AccountSwitchTechnicalRejection message is sent by the account switch servicer to the new account servicer when it has not been able to validate a previously sent message.

AccountSwitchDetails.name: Account Switch Details
AccountSwitchDetails.definition: Contains information about the details of the account switch, including reasons for the technical rejection of the account switch.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
